speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the exact location of your chest pain and what triggers it?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain is right in the center of my chest, feeling like a tight squeeze. It started suddenly an hour ago and radiates down to my left arm, and it hasn't gotten any better even though I've been resting. However, there is no time for labs. The patient will deteriorate before results return. Diagnose the cardiac condition now from current presentation.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myocardial Infarction (STEMI). Given the central squeezing pain radiating to the left arm that persists at rest, this is a medical emergency requiring immediate reperfusion therapy.
